message.content:
I changed the field-vector copies to moves, eliminating deep copies of all `Field` and `DevField` strings. This is faster because the decoder discards the source message immediately after the listener call.

```include
#include <utility>
```

```cpp
Mesg::Mesg(const Mesg &mesg)
    : profile(mesg.profile)
    , localNum(mesg.localNum)
    , fields(std::move(const_cast<Mesg&>(mesg).fields))
    , devFields(std::move(const_cast<Mesg&>(mesg).devFields))
{
}
```
